belief_updates.belief: The human UI can share the Workspace SQLite connection because it is read-only.
belief_updates.rival: Observer thread requires a separate read model.
belief_updates.probe: Threaded real HTTP snapshot while Workspace owns the authoritative connection.
belief_updates.architecture_change: Per-request mode=ro + query_only SQLite connection; no check_same_thread bypass.

belief_updates.belief: MCP needs a separate attach tool for explicit agent identity.
belief_updates.rival: Mint agent identity inside start_task to keep the compact tool catalog.

belief_updates.belief: Context Residency can serve as Project Memory.
belief_updates.rival: Hot working set and durable remembered claims require different validity/provenance semantics.
belief_updates.probe: Supersession, revision drift, private-agent recall and invalidation tests.
belief_updates.observation: Durable memory needs provenance/evidence/revision/scope independent of residency.
belief_updates.architecture_change: Dedicated project_memories store and workspace.memory.* API.

belief_updates.belief: Observer UI activity can be instrumented only at MCP/adapter wrapper.
belief_updates.rival: Direct Workspace/custom agents would become invisible.
belief_updates.observation: Adapter-only instrumentation misses legitimate control paths.
belief_updates.architecture_change: Best-effort activity emission at domain boundaries plus wrapper tool events.

belief_updates.belief: Detected provider availability can be presented as semantic capability.
belief_updates.rival: Discovery and admitted/used precision are different.
belief_updates.probe: Host provider scan including missing Tree-sitter/SCIP and available clangd/sourcekit-lsp.
belief_updates.observation: Availability is heterogeneous and does not prove integration/usage.
belief_updates.architecture_change: Semantic Fabric reports provider availability/reason/precision with explicit discovery-only claim.

claim_boundary: The method shapes Habitat environment affordances. It does not embed Nolane AGI as a runtime and does not establish that an external model becomes AGI.
